data.label: Website Check
data.title:
5 signs your website is
*losing you customers*
data.sub: Swipe and check your own site →

data.label: Sign #1
data.title: It looks *broken on phones*
data.body: Most of your customers search for your services on their phones. If they have to pinch and zoom to read your text, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Test your site on your phone today.

data.label: Sign #2
data.title: Your site *loads slowly*
data.body: If your website takes more than a few seconds to load, potential customers will hit the back button. Speed is everything for local businesses.
data.fix: Fix: Resize your large images to be smaller.

data.label: Sign #3
data.title: Customers can't find *your contact info*
data.body: A customer shouldn't have to hunt for your phone number or address. If they can't find it in three seconds, they will call a competitor.
data.fix: Fix: Put your phone number in the header.

data.label: Sign #4
data.title: Your content is *outdated*
data.body: An old copyright date or expired offers make your business look closed or unreliable. Keep your site current to build instant trust.
data.fix: Fix: Update your copyright year and pricing.

data.label: Sign #5
data.title: No clear *call to action*
data.body: Your website needs to tell customers exactly what to do next. Without a clear button, they won't know how to book your service.
data.fix: Fix: Add a 'Call Now' button on top.
